meta.title: National Center for Accreditation — redesign concept
meta.description: An unofficial concept for the new NCA website: registry, accreditation process, documents and training.

concept: Unofficial redesign concept. Registry data is for demonstration only.

org.parent: Committee for Technical Regulation and Metrology, Ministry of Trade and Integration of Kazakhstan

hero.title: Check whether a laboratory or certification body is accredited
hero.lead: Enter the organization name, certificate number or BIN. The registry updates after every NCA order.
hero.nothing: No matches. Check the certificate number: it looks like KZ.T.02.0347.

steps.title: How accreditation works
steps.lead: Five stages from application to certificate. Applications are filed online through the Technical Regulation information system.

items.title: Preparation
items.text: Bring your management system in line with ISO/IEC 17025, 17065 or the standard for your activity.

items.title: Application
items.text: Submit the application and documents on techreg.gov.kz, signed with the director’s digital signature.

items.title: Document review
items.text: An assessor reviews the documents and scope. Findings arrive in your personal account.

items.title: On-site assessment
items.text: An assessment team checks staff, equipment, methods and records on site.

items.title: Decision and certificate
items.text: The commission decides, NCA issues an order and a certificate, and the organization enters the registry.

items.title: Regulatory documents
items.text: Laws, orders, procedures and standard forms

footer.rights: This concept was made for learning purposes and is not the official NCA website.

training.title: Training for specialists
training.lead: Courses on accreditation standards for staff of laboratories, certification and inspection bodies. Taught by NCA assessors.

steps.text: Choose a course and session, add your organization and participants. Takes about 5 minutes.

steps.title: Contract and invoice
steps.text: The training department reviews the application and emails the contract and invoice.
